d: When it comes to building strength at home, which is better, dumbbells or resistance tubing? In this video, we break down the pros and cons of each, including joint comfort, stability demands, ease of use and how to progress safely, so you can choose the option that fits your goals and workout style. Whether you're just getting started or looking to refine your routine, this comparison will help you train with confidence and get the most out of every workout.
